cohort: Pregnant women without pre-existing diabetes who underwent a glucose tolerance test between 23 and 30 weeks gestation from Wisconsin (USA), Doha (Qatar), and Cape Town (South Africa).
finding: The NPRP criterion categorizes pregnant women into four distinct glycemic risk clusters (NGG, IGG, GDM, hGDM) which are associated with increased odds of large for gestational age babies, pregnancy induced hypertension, and progression to Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus depending on the category.
